name: fighter-auto

webgpu.note: the same dual cart on romdev and Chromium against native WebGPU

note: Fighter: two CPU fighters (Bolt and Vex, rooftop) play from the intro. The rules are integer only (sim.c), so the named state must match exactly on every host; pixels within the usual tolerance (particles, dust).

name: fighter-p1-moves
note: Player 1 types a quarter circle + light on a pad stick: a fireball leaves and crosses the stage (the control leaves the motion out and no fireball flies).

name: fighter-training
note: Training mode with hitboxes shown (view.boxes counts the boxes drawn): the dummy stands, player 1 plays the same script.

name: hordeshooter-match
note: hordeshooter_auto: two bots hold the yard for 900 ticks (15 s). The crowd, the shots and the blasts are all simulation, so every host agrees on the state.

name: hordeshooter-pace
note: hordeshooter_auto: two bots for 40 s: first kill, the first upgrade choices (bots pick), wave 2. Exact state on every host.
